lines: The source's semidirect-product Proposition1.9 additionally requires the quotient action K on P/H to be CCT. Knowing the sign-flip subgroup and abstract coordinate-permutation group are separately familiar does not establish that quotient-action hypothesis. Its product/wreath-product preservation results concern their specified product actions; the imprimitive action of the hyperoctahedral group on2n signed coordinate directions is different from its action on2^n cube vertices.
